# env/measured.txt — the environment as measured on 2026-11-26, WD13.

# This is a pip constraints file. It does not install anything. It fixes the
# version of any package the resolver happens to need, so that
# env/requirements.lock reproduces the environment this project has actually
# been working in rather than whatever is newest on the day it is regenerated.
#
# Without it, eight transitive packages resolved newer than measured on
# 2026-11-26, one of them cuda-pathfinder, which sits in the CUDA library
# discovery path (finding F62).
#
# Generated by:  pip list --format=freeze | sort
# Consumed by:   pip-compile --constraint env/measured.txt
#
# Packages not listed here are unconstrained on purpose: numpy, pytest, ruff
# and mypy were not installed when this snapshot was taken, so they have no
# measured version to preserve and the resolver chooses them freely.
#
# Changing a version here is a deliberate act. Do not regenerate this file to
# match a drifted environment; decide, then regenerate.
